vr1022006.title: Giratina VSTAR UR 261/172 S12a VSTAR Universe Gold Japanese Pokemon Card No.2

tcg.title: Giratina VSTAR UR 261/172 S12a VSTAR Universe Gold Japanese Pokemon Card No.2
tcg.about: Giratina VSTAR UR 261/172 from the Japanese expansion pack VSTAR Universe (S12a), an Ultra Rare gold card with the VSTAR power Star Requiem that knocks out the opponent's Battle Pokemon when you have 10 or more cards in your Lost Zone. HP 280, illustrated by AKIRA EGAWA. It is kept in a sleeve. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: An Ultra Rare gold Giratina VSTAR from VSTAR Universe with full-art holo artwork.
tcg.perfect: Pokemon card collectors who want this card.
